payload.name: pc-check-mode
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that accepts only the exact strings 'eco' or 'boost' (case-sensitive, no normalization) and returns an invalid-result object for any other value, including missing mode. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('mode') so absence is a valid invalid-result, never raises. Returns {accepted, mode} where mode is the original string when accepted and null otherwise. No imports, host calls, I/O or coercion; booleans and other JSON values are rejected, not coerced.

composition_summary: Drafted one class-22 pure-logic validator pc-check-mode. The body reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('mode') so a missing key yields an invalid result rather than raising, and returns {accepted, mode} with mode null when not accepted. It accepts only the exact case-sensitive strings 'eco'/'boost', rejects booleans and other JSON values without coercion, and assigns result on every path with no imports/host/I/O. This is an offline-design draft; the host sink supports class 22 name/description/content, and typed-input transport and Monty execution remain target interfaces requiring Q1, human Q2 and behavioral validation before activation. No submission, approval or activation occurred; conversation preserved unchanged.
